heading: Positional type classification
text:
## Positional type classification [LGRA.22]

An identifier's role — type reference or binding — is fixed by grammatical
**position**, and case plays no part ([LGRA.2.5], [LNAM.2.1]). This section
is the normative home for that model; [LCST] and
[LEXP] reference it for how a `NAME` resolves in a cast target
and in expression position.
